title_i18n.zh: 打破向量检索的局限：RAG 混合检索实践
title_i18n.en: Breaking the Limitations of Vector Retrieval: RAG Hybrid Retrieval Practices
title_i18n.es: Superando las limitaciones de la búsqueda vectorial: Práctica de búsqueda híbrida con RAG

excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文分析了纯向量检索架构 RAG 流程存在的局限性，并介绍了内部全量检索应用如何借助倒数排名融合（RRF） 整合 BM25 与向量检索结果来优化检索方案。
excerpt_i18n.en: This paper analyzes the limitations of the pure vector retrieval architecture in the RAG pipeline and introduces how an internal full-scale retrieval application optimizes the retrieval approach by integrating BM25 and vector retrieval results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

The 2026 FIFA World Cup in the USA, Canada, and Mexico is approaching. Today, Qianwen held the launch salon for its first football prediction AI assistant. Users are invited to predict match scores to earn points. Participants can not only help Qianwen donate football fields to rural schools but also have the chance to win a cash prize of 10,000 yuan.  

Qianwen Launches Football Prediction AI Assistant  
The first football prediction AI assistant has been launched, integrating big data such as weather and terrain. This will be the first World Cup where AI fully participates in match predictions. Qianwen’s football prediction AI assistant is now open to all users. Cheng Fei, head of Qianwen’s AI prediction product, explained that the assistant is trained on vast amounts of big data, including historical data, player statistics, injury reports, and even terrain data of the USA, Canada, and Mexico, as well as weather data during match periods.  

Using the example of the group stage match between Norway and Senegal on June 22, Cheng Fei noted that Norway, with world-class striker Erling Haaland, might seem likely to win. However, Qianwen predicted a 1-1 draw.  

“The reason for this prediction is the weather,” Cheng Fei explained. “Since this World Cup is hosted by three countries, matches may face completely different weather conditions. Qianwen considers factors such as temperature, humidity, kickoff time, and the typical playing environments of both teams.” Similarly, weather and altitude will affect the opening match between Mexico and South Africa. Qianwen predicts a Mexican victory, not only due to home-field advantage but also because of the special factor of Mexico City’s altitude of over 2,200 meters.
